```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Photo-sharing website with custom VPC, web tier in public subnets, and RDS MySQL database in private subnets'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for web servers
  
  AdminCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    Description: CIDR block for administrator SSH access

Resources:
  PhotoSharingVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoSharingVPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoSharingIGW

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web servers
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTPS from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCIDR
          Description: SSH from admin network
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web servers only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DatabaseSecurityGroup

  WebServerLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: |
            #!/bin/bash
            yum update -y
            yum install -y httpd php php-mysql
            systemctl start httpd
            systemctl enable httpd
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebServerLaunchTemplate

  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebServer1

  WebServerEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebServerEIP

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoSharingDBSubnetGroup

  DBSecretPassword:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: Master password for RDS database
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "admin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  PhotoSharingDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: photosharingdb
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0.35'
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${DBSecretPassword}:SecretString:password}}'
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt DBEncryptionKey.Arn
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      DBName: photosharing
      MultiAZ: false
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general
        - slowquery
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoSharingDatabase

  DBEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for RDS encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM policies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow RDS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
            Resource: '*'

  DBEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/photosharingdb-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DBEncryptionKey

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: URL of the photo-sharing website
    Value: !Sub 'http://${WebServerEIP}'

  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: RDS database endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoSharingDatabase.Endpoint.Address
```

```yaml
    Properties:
```
